procedure_name: Initial Registration Accepted by the Network
description: The procedure for when the initial registration request is accepted by the network.

parameters: UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE

edges.event: Network slicing information changes, CAG information, operator defined access category definitions, Extended emergency number list, UE radio capability ID or Negotiated PEIPS assistance information received

conditionals.condition: REGISTRATION REQUEST message received over non-3GPP access
conditionals.action: The AMF shall include a single TAI in the TAI list.

conditionals.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains a list of equivalent PLMNs
conditionals.action: The UE shall store the list.

conditionals.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains network slicing information changes, NSAG information IE
conditionals.action: The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.

conditionals.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE and the UE had set the CAG bit to CAG supported in the 5GMM capability IE
conditionals.action: The UE shall replace the CAG information list or remove the serving VPLMN's entry

conditionals.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the Operator-defined access category definitions IE ,the Extended emergency number list IE ,the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE
conditionals.action: The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF

conditionals.condition: UE has set the RCMAP bit to Sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for negotiated PEIPS parameters supported and REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE
conditionals.action: The UE shall return REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF

conditionals.condition: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the UE radio capability ID IE or the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE
conditionals.action: The UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF
